module: Flowgraph node "Drag Race State" (category repeat_instant). Pure monitoring node for the drag race state (data from gameplay_drag_dragBridge.getData). Outputs: flow, started, completed, staged, countdownOver (pulses), isStarted, isCompleted, isStaged (bool), dragType (drag, bracketRace, headsUpRace), context (freeroam, activity...), localPhase (stage, countdown, race, stop).
notes: Without race data, all outputs are reset to false or empty string.
Overwrites self.data (the node's data table) with {} at start.

work.desc: Reads dragBridge.getData(), detects the started/completed transitions and the phase changes of the playable driver.
